rules.title: Every input file parses as JSON (no duplicate keys) and the policy set is non-empty
Each policy has the conditionalAccessPolicy shape: required keys present, no unknown keys, correct types
state is one of enabled | disabled | enabledForReportingButNotEnforced
conditions (users, applications, clientAppTypes, platforms, locations, risk levels) are well-formed with known values
grantControls well-formed: operator AND|OR, known builtInControls, block is exclusive, at least one control
Policy ids and displayNames are unique across the set
Break-glass accounts are excluded from every policy (and never explicitly included)
Legacy authentication (exchangeActiveSync + other) is blocked for All users on All apps by an enabled policy
An enabled policy requires MFA for All users on All apps (AND semantics, only break-glass excluded)
All privileged admin roles require phishing-resistant MFA via an enabled policy with no role exclusions
No policy blocks All users without exclusions
An enabled policy requires a compliant device for All users on All apps
Risk-based policies (sign-in / user risk) are report-only during staged rollout
